bounds.name: sieve_x_positions
bounds.condition: all 16 walks eligible; upper bound if earlier termination

bounds.name: two_bucket_passes
bounds.condition: all 16 walks eligible; excludes other work

bounds.name: bucket_vec_headers
bounds.condition: 24-byte Vec header on intended64bit ABI; excludes buffers, allocator overhead, RSS

early_rejection.condition: 16 eligible walks, valid smooth odd-characteristic quintic and valid degree2 Mumford input

candidate_changes.name: compact reusable buckets
candidate_changes.obligation: root multiplicity, exceptional appends, exact lambda/root order, full reset and primitive ledger

candidate_changes.name: rational-x inventory plus quadratic exceptional roots
candidate_changes.obligation: complete roots of u, preserve every candidate and charge factoring/inversions

candidate_changes.name: sorted sparse rows or exact path compression
candidate_changes.obligation: same row space, pivot order, transient caps, pending row retention and complete accounting
